facts.activity_file: controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch
atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work

facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at PSV-8210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch on PSV-8210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas. PSV-8210 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 31 January 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during a planned shutdown; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
